answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The island of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
